title: Concept: Profile active by default
description: pom.xml declares a profile that applies without being requested, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a profile that applies without being requested.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pom.xml (maven).
